posts.text: 🚨 Alleged Gulfjobs Breach Exposes 872k Candidate Records on Darkweb A darkweb forum post claims that approximately 872,000 records from the Saudi Arabian job portal Gulfjobs have been leaked, exposing detailed personal and professional information of job seekers. The listing alleges that the data includes user registration details, authentication logs, and extensive third-party platform mappings across three distinct categories. According to the post, the compromised dataset contains 50 unique data fields divided into the following sections: * **Contacts:** Personal details including email addresses, full names, dates of birth, mobile and landline phone numbers, street addresses, nationality, marital status, and LinkedIn profiles. * **Candidate Profiles:** Sensitive background information such as passport numbers, passport issue/expiry dates, total work experience, health problems, physical disabilities, weight, height, police clearance certificates, current and expected salaries, and resume file paths. * **Job Applications:** Recruitment metadata including applied job titles, application statuses, interview results, offer statuses, background check results, visa status, onboarding status, and internal recruiter notes. Gulfjobs is a prominent online recruitment platform in the Middle East, serving as a key resource for job seekers and employers in Saudi Arabia and the wider region. The exposure of passport numbers and health data raises significant privacy concerns for the affected individuals. The actor behind the leak provided verification links via Gofile and requested transactions through a neutral escrow service. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Gulfjobs or security researchers.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 涉嫌洩密的 Gulfjobs 在暗網上洩露了 872,000 條求職者記錄 一篇暗網論壇帖子聲稱，沙特阿拉伯求職門戶網站 Gulfjobs 的約 872,000 條記錄已被洩露，暴露了求職者的詳細個人和專業信息。該清單稱，這些數據包括用戶註冊詳細資訊、身份驗證日誌以及跨三個不同類別的廣泛第三方平台映射。根據該帖子，受損的資料集包含 50 個獨特的資料字段，分為以下部分： * **聯絡人：** 個人詳細信息，包括電子郵件地址、全名、出生日期、手機和固定電話號碼、街道地址、國籍、婚姻狀況和 LinkedIn 個人資料。 * **候選人簡介：** 敏感的背景信息，例如護照號碼、護照簽發/到期日期、總工作經驗、健康問題、身體殘疾、體重、身高、無犯罪記錄證明、當前和預期工資以及簡歷文件路徑。 * **職位申請：** 招聘元數據，包括申請的職位名稱、申請狀態、面試結果、錄取通知狀態、背景調查結果、簽證狀態、入職狀態和內部招聘人員說明。 Gulfjobs 是中東地區著名的線上招聘平台，是沙烏地阿拉伯及更廣泛地區求職者和雇主的重要資源。護照號碼和健康資料的暴露給受影響的個人帶來了嚴重的隱私問題。洩漏事件背後的攻擊者透過 Gofile 提供驗證鏈接，並透過中立託管服務請求交易。截至本報告發布之時，Gulfjobs 或安全研究人員尚未對所指控的違規行為進行獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Massive Breach of Defense Contractor IMCO Group A threat actor operating under the alias 'Cyber_Isnaad_Front' has posted on an underground forum claiming to have breached IMCO Group, a major defense and aerospace contractor. The post alleges that the group accessed sensitive sections of the company's infrastructure in Israel, the United States, and Europe, dumping over 250 terabytes of data. The actor demands $700,000 in Bitcoin or Monero for the full dataset, offering proof-of-concept files with the password 'CyberIsnaadFront'. According to the listing, the stolen data includes: - CCTV images and videos from the U.S. branch - Confidential documents and engineering blueprints - Employee personal and identity information for over 500 staff across 7 sites in 3 countries - Department of Defense (DoD) contracts - Communications with subsidiaries, partners, and major customers including Rafael Advanced Defense Systems, Elbit Systems, Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI), U.S. Naval Forces, U.S. Air Forces, IDF, and ATENA - Product information, operational tests, defects, and weaknesses of specific military-defense products - Videos of managers' meetings with customers IMCO Group is a significant player in the defense industry, known for manufacturing unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and providing services to military clients globally. The alleged exposure of engineering blueprints and defect reports for military products could pose severe national security risks if authentic. The actor claims to have full access to work contracts and internal communications involving high-profile defense entities. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by IMCO Group or third-party security researchers. No contact details for the threat actor are included in this report. #DataBreach #IMCOGroup #DefenseIndustry #Cyber_Isnaad_Front #Ransomware
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱大規模破壞了國防承包商 IMCO 集團 一名化名“Cyber​​_Isnaad_Front”的威脅行為者在地下論壇上發帖，聲稱已經破壞了主要國防和航空航天承包商 IMCO 集團的行為。該貼文稱，該組織訪問了該公司位於以色列、美國和歐洲的基礎設施的敏感部分，洩漏了超過 250 TB 的資料。該攻擊者要求 70 萬美元的比特幣或門羅幣來獲取完整資料集，並提供密碼為「Cyber​​IsnaadFront」的概念驗證檔案。根據清單，被盜資料包括： - 來自美國分公司的閉路電視影像和影片 - 機密文件和工程藍圖 - 3 個國家 7 個地點的 500 多名員工的個人和身分資訊 - 國防部 (DoD) 合約 - 與子公司、合作夥伴和主要客戶的通訊，包括拉斐爾、英國先進系統公司、艾爾比特系統、以色列航空軍國防公司、以色列航空國防公司 (IIA）、以色列航空系統先進系統公司、以色列航空系統公司、以色列航空軍國防公司和美國國防軍公司（IIA）。 ATENA - 特定軍事防禦產品的產品資訊、操作測試、缺陷和弱點 - 經理與客戶會議的視訊 IMCO 集團是國防工業的重要參與者，以製造無人機 (UAV) 和為全球軍事客戶提供服務而聞名。所謂的軍用產品工程圖和缺陷報告的曝光如果屬實，可能會構成嚴重的國家安全風險。該演員聲稱可以完全存取涉及知名國防實體的工作合約和內部通訊。截至本報告發布之時，IMCO 集團或第三方安全研究人員尚未對所指控的違規行為進行獨立核實。此報告中未包含威脅行為者的詳細聯絡資訊。 #DataBreach #IMCOGroup #DefenseIndustry #Cyber​​_Isnaad_Front #Ransomware

posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱對 IMCO USA 造成了 250 TB 的大規模破壞 一名化名「Cyber​​IsnaadFront」的威脅行為者聲稱已經破壞了 IMCO 集團在美國和歐洲的業務，據稱洩露了超過 250 TB 的敏感資料。根據地下論壇上的一篇帖子，該組織訪問了該公司基礎設施的主要部分，並洩露了大量機密資料。該行為者聲稱，被盜的資料集包括： - 來自美國分公司的閉路電視影像和影片 - 機密工程藍圖 - 歐洲和美國部門的員工機密資訊 - 國防部 (DoD) 合約 IMCO 集團是一家總部位於中東的著名工業集團，在石油和天然氣、石化和工程領域擁有重要的全球業務。該公司持有大量國防和基礎設施合同，這使得國防部相關文件的曝光尤其敏感。該帖子提供了概念驗證連結來驗證聲明，使用密碼“Cyber​​IsnaadFront”。攻擊者要求透過電子郵件或 Tox Messenger 進行聯繫，但最初的貼文中沒有說明具體的贖金金額或截止日期。截至本報告發布之時，IMCO 集團或第三方安全公司尚未對涉嫌違規行為進行獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actors Claim 58GB Breach of Michoacán Government Procurement Portal A darkweb forum post reveals that threat actors claiming to be 'homercracker' and 'cenfecracked' have allegedly breached the digital procurement platform of the Michoacán State Government in Mexico. The actors claim to have exfiltrated over 58 GB of data from the Comité de Adquisiciones del Poder Ejecutivo (CADPE), the official portal used for public tenders, supplier registration, and internal administrative processes. According to the listing on an underground forum, the compromised dataset includes 37,037 documents containing sensitive personal and fiscal information for suppliers and contractors. The alleged leak exposes a wide range of private data, organized by the RFC (tax ID) of each individual or company. The types of data reportedly exposed include: * INE credentials (Mexican voter IDs) * Full names, CURP (unique population registry code), and RFC * Constancia de domicilio fiscal (proof of fiscal address) and photographs of addresses * Professional licenses (Cédulas profesionales) * Financial statements from the last two months * Corporate charters (Acta constitutiva de la empresa) * SAT tax compliance opinions and payment receipts * Email contacts and official IDs of legal representatives Michoacán is one of Mexico's most populous states, with a significant public sector workforce and extensive government procurement activities. A breach of this scale could expose thousands of citizens and businesses to identity theft and fraud, given the inclusion of government-issued identification documents and financial records. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or official statements from the Michoacán State Government. #DataBreach #Mexico #Michoacan #GovernmentHack #IdentityTheft #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱 58GB 破壞了米卻肯州政府採購門戶 一篇暗網論壇帖子顯示，自稱“homercracker”和“cenfecracked”的威脅行為者據稱已經破壞了墨西哥米卻肯州政府的數字採購平台。攻擊者聲稱從 Comité de Adquisiciones del Poder Ejecutivo (CADPE) 竊取了超過 58 GB 的數據，CADPE 是用於公開招標、供應商註冊和內部管理流程的官方入口網站。根據地下論壇上的列表，受損的資料集包括 37,037 個文件，其中包含供應商和承包商的敏感個人和財務資訊。所謂的洩漏暴露了由每個個人或公司的 RFC（稅號）組織的廣泛私人資料。據報道，暴露的資料類型包括： * INE 憑證（墨西哥選民 ID） * 全名、CURP（唯一人口登記代碼）和 RFC * Constancia de domicilio fiscal（財務地址證明）和地址照片 * 專業執照 (Cédulas profesionales) * 過去兩個月的財務報表 * 公司照片 * 專業執照合規ID法律代表 米卻肯州是墨西哥人口最多的州之一，擁有大量公共部門勞動力和廣泛的政府採購活動。鑑於其中包含政府頒發的身份證件和財務記錄，這種規模的違規行為可能會使數千名公民和企業面臨身份盜竊和欺詐。截至撰寫報告時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到安全研究人員或米卻肯州政府官方聲明的獨立核實。 #DataBreach #墨西哥 #Michoacan #GovernmentHack #IdentityTheft #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨Threat Actor Claims Sale of 124M SMSA Express Records on Darkweb A post on an underground forum alleges the sale of a massive dataset belonging to SMSA Express, a leading courier and logistics provider in Saudi Arabia. The actor claims to possess 261.40 GB of data comprising 124,734,059 unique records, each containing detailed personally identifiable information (PII) for both senders and receivers. According to the listing, the exposed data includes: - Barcode [tracking number] - Owner, PackPacking, TotalNumberOFpieces, TotalWeight, PackageStatus, PDAScan - SenderName, ReceiverName - SenderContactPhone1, ReceiverContactPhone1 - SenderAddressLine1, ReceiverAddressLine1 - SenderCity, RecieverCity - DeclaredValue, DeclaredCurrency, CommodityDesc - SenderPhone, RecieverPhone, IsActive SMSA Express is a significant player in the Middle Eastern logistics sector, operating since 1994 with services spanning international and domestic express transportation, freight, customs clearance, and e-commerce solutions. The company reportedly connects a network across 230 countries, serving tens of thousands of businesses and individuals. The threat actor states that the data is available for a one-time sale or escrow session, with the price being negotiable. A PGP key fingerprint was provided in the post for secure communication. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified. #DataBreach #SMSAExpress #LogisticsSecurity #DarkWeb #PII #SaudiArabia #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: 🚨威脅行為者聲稱在暗網上出售了 1.24 億條 SMSA Express 記錄地下論壇上的一篇帖子聲稱出售了屬於沙烏地阿拉伯領先的快遞和物流提供商 SMSA Express 的大量數據集。該攻擊者聲稱擁有 261.40 GB 的數據，其中包括 124,734,059 條獨特的記錄，每筆記錄都包含發送者和接收者的詳細個人識別資訊 (PII)。根據清單，暴露的資料包括： - 條碼[追蹤號碼] - Owner、PackPacking、TotalNumberOFpieces、TotalWeight、PackageStatus、PDAScan - SenderName、ReceiverName - SenderContactPhone1、ReceiverContactPhone1 - SenderAddressLine1、ReceiverSmendine1、Re還DeclaredValue、DeclaredCurrency、CommodityDesc - SenderPhone、RecieverPhone、IsActive SMSA Express 是中東物流領域的重要參與者，自 1994 年開始運營，提供的服務涵蓋國際和國內快遞運輸、貨運、清關和電子商務解決方案。據報道，該公司連接了遍布 230 個國家的網絡，為數以萬計的企業和個人提供服務。威脅行為者表示，這些數據可用於一次性銷售或託管會話，價格可以協商。帖子中提供了 PGP 金鑰指紋以確保安全通訊。截至本報告發布之時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到獨立核實。 #DataBreach #SMSAExpress #LogisticsSecurity #DarkWeb #PII #SaudiArabia #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Full Database Breach of Moroccan Medical Provider Distamed A post on an underground forum alleges that the full database of Distamed, a major Moroccan medical device and healthcare solutions provider, has been compromised. The threat actor claims to have extracted the company's entire archive dating back to its establishment in 2013, including sensitive patient records and internal business documents. According to the listing on the darkweb forum, the stolen dataset includes: * Full client lists and complete patient records * Internal files, billing documents, invoices, and document scans * Data related to dealings with government institutions, including Moroccan military hospitals and public hospitals The post specifies that the exposed patient data contains highly sensitive personally identifiable information (PII), including: * Last name and first name * Phone number and address * Age and date of visit * CIN (National ID number) Distamed is described in the post as a leading provider of medical technologies to hospitals and clinics across Morocco, specializing in cardiology, pulmonology, neurology, sleep diagnostics, rehabilitation, and medical imaging. If authentic, the exposure of national ID numbers and medical histories for patients treated at military and public institutions could pose significant privacy risks and regulatory challenges under Moroccan data protection laws. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Distamed or third-party security researchers. #DataBreach #Distamed #Morocco #HealthcareSecurity #PII #DarkWeb #CyberSecurity
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱摩洛哥醫療提供者 Distamed 的完整資料庫遭到破壞 地下論壇上的一篇貼文聲稱，摩洛哥主要醫療設備和醫療保健解決方案提供商 Distamed 的完整資料庫已被洩露。威脅行為者聲稱提取了該公司自 2013 年成立以來的全部檔案，包括敏感的患者記錄和內部業務文件。根據暗網論壇上的列表，被盜的數據集包括： * 完整的客戶列表和完整的患者記錄 * 內部文件、賬單文件、發票和文檔掃描 * 與政府機構（包括摩洛哥軍事醫院和公立醫院）打交道相關的數據 該帖子指出，暴露的患者數據包含高度敏感的個人身份信息（PII），包括： * 姓氏和姓名 電話號碼就診和姓名在貼文中被描述為領先的提供者向摩洛哥各地的醫院和診所提供醫療技術，專門從事心臟病學、肺病學、神經病學、睡眠診斷、復健和醫學影像。如果屬實，在軍事和公共機構接受治療的患者的國民身分證號碼和病史的曝光可能會根據摩洛哥資料保護法帶來重大的隱私風險和監管挑戰。截至報告之時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到 Distamed 或第三方安全研究人員的獨立驗證。 #DataBreach #Distamed #Morocco #HealthcareSecurity #PII #DarkWeb #Cyber​​Security

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged Decathlon Database of 160M Records Listed for Sale on Darkweb A threat actor has listed a database allegedly containing 160 million records from the global sporting goods retailer Decathlon for sale on an underground forum. The listing, posted on July 23, 2026, claims to offer comprehensive customer data in exchange for $400 via cryptocurrency. According to the post, the dataset includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) and account credentials for customers across multiple countries, including Brazil, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands. The seller provided sample entries demonstrating the depth of the alleged leak. The exposed data fields reportedly include: * Customer identifiers and contact details (email, phone number) * Password hashes (using bcrypt algorithm) * Full names and dates of birth * Physical addresses (street, city, postal code, region) * Account activity metrics (member since, last order date, orders count, total spent) * Loyalty program details (points, vouchers redeemed) * Personal preferences (favorite sports, preferred store, signup platform) Decathlon is one of the world's largest sporting goods retailers, operating thousands of stores across more than 70 countries. A breach of this scale would represent a significant compromise of customer privacy and could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns or identity theft if the password hashes are cracked. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or confirmed by Decathlon.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 據稱包含 1.6 億筆記錄的迪卡儂資料庫在暗網上出售 一名威脅行為者在地下論壇上列出了一個據稱包含全球體育用品零售商迪卡儂 1.6 億筆記錄的資料庫。該清單發佈於 2026 年 7 月 23 日，聲稱可以提供全面的客戶數據，並透過加密貨幣換取 400 美元。根據該帖子，該資料集包括多個國家（包括巴西、德國、法國、西班牙、義大利、英國和荷蘭）客戶的敏感個人識別資訊（PII）和帳戶憑證。賣方提供了樣本條目，證明了所稱洩漏的深度。根據報告，暴露的資料欄位包括： * 客戶識別碼和聯絡資訊（電子郵件、電話號碼） * 密碼雜湊（使用 bcrypt 演算法） * 全名和出生日期 * 實際地址（街道、城市、郵遞區號、地區） * 帳戶活動指標（會員開始日期、最後訂單日期、訂單數、總支出） * 忠誠度計畫、地區） * 帳戶活動指標（會員開始日期、最後訂單日期、訂單數、總支出） * 忠誠度計畫詳細資料（迪卡儂是世界上最大的運動之一商品零售商，在 70 多個國家經營數千家商店。如此規模的違規將意味著對客戶隱私的重大損害，如果密碼雜湊被破解，則可能會促進有針對性的網路釣魚活動或身分盜竊。截至報告發佈時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到安全研究人員的獨立核實或迪卡儂的確認。

posts.text: ⚠️ Alleged Leak of Saudi Arabian Teachers' PII on Underground Forum A darkweb forum post claims to expose a database containing personal and professional details of Saudi Arabian citizens, specifically targeting educators. According to the listing, the leaked dataset includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) such as national IDs, full names, contact details, and employment records. The post provides a sample of the data, which allegedly contains the following fields: * National ID numbers * Full names (including father's and grandfather's names) * Birth dates (Hijri and Gregorian) * Email addresses and mobile phone numbers * Job titles and current positions * Employer school names and ministry numbers * University qualifications and GPAs The sample data appears to focus on teachers employed in the Hail region of Saudi Arabia, with entries referencing specific schools such as "Abdullah bin Yameer Primary School" and universities like "King Khaled University" and "Umm Al-Qura University." The actor alleges that the breach involves a significant volume of records, though the total number of affected individuals is not specified in the initial post. If authentic, the exposure of national ID numbers and employment details for government employees could facilitate identity theft, social engineering attacks, or targeted harassment against educators in the Kingdom. The incident highlights ongoing risks to government sector databases in the Middle East. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or official statements from Saudi Arabian authorities. #DataBreach #SaudiArabia #EducationSector #PII #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: ⚠️ 地下論壇涉嫌洩露沙烏地阿拉伯教師的 PII 一篇暗網論壇貼文聲稱公開了一個資料庫，其中包含沙烏地阿拉伯公民的個人和職業詳細信息，特別是針對教育工作者。根據清單，洩漏的資料集包括敏感的個人識別資訊（PII），例如身分證、全名、聯絡資訊和就業記錄。該帖子提供了一個資料樣本，據稱包含以下欄位： * 國民身分證號碼 * 全名（包括父親和祖父的名字） * 出生日期（回曆和公曆） * 電子郵件地址和手機號碼 * 職稱和當前職位 * 雇主學校名稱和部門編號 * 大學學歷和 GPA 樣本數據似乎集中在沙特阿拉伯哈伊勒地區僱用的教師，“Abdullah 學校” Primary」學院」以及「哈立德國王大學」和「烏姆古拉大學」等大學。能會助長身分盜竊、社會工程攻擊或針對沙烏地王國教育工作者的有針對性的騷擾。 #DataBreach #SaudiArabia #EducationSector #PII #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Sells Domain Admin Access to Turkish Automotive Firm A listing on the SiberianShelves darkweb marketplace claims to offer persistent access to a Turkish automotive company with an estimated annual revenue between $1 billion and $5 billion. The post, published on July 26, 2026, advertises an ASPX webshell that allegedly provides Domain Admin privileges across a network of approximately 2,500 hosts. According to the listing, the access point is undetected by existing antivirus or endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions. The seller lists the price for the credentials at 0.00208152 BTC (equivalent to 208,152 satoshis) and directs interested buyers to contact them via direct message or through the marketplace. The target profile described in the post includes: * Industry: Automotive * Country: Turkey * Estimated Revenue: $1B - $5B * Network Size: ~2,500 hosts * Access Type: ASPX Webshell with Domain Admin rights Turkey’s automotive sector is a significant contributor to the national economy, with major manufacturing hubs and export operations. A breach of this scale could expose sensitive intellectual property, supply chain data, or customer information if the actor leverages the high-level administrative access. At the time of reporting, the specific identity of the affected organization has not been disclosed, and the alleged breach has not been independently verified.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者出售土耳其汽車公司的域名管理訪問權限 SiberianShelves 暗網市場上的一個列表聲稱可以提供對一家土耳其汽車公司的持久訪問權限，該公司的年收入估計在 10 億至 50 億美元之間。該貼文發佈於 2026 年 7 月 26 日，宣傳了一個 ASPX Webshel​​l，據稱該 Webshel​​l 在大約 2,500 台主機的網路中提供網域管理員權限。根據清單，現有的防毒或端點偵測和回應 (EDR) 解決方案無法偵測到該存取點。賣家將憑證的價格列為 0.00208152 BTC（相當於 208,152 聰），並指示有興趣的買家透過直接訊息或透過市場與他們聯繫。貼文中所述的目標概況包括： * 產業：汽車 * 國家：土耳其 * 預計收入：$1B - $5B * 網路規模：約 2,500 個主機 * 存取類型：具有網域管理權限的 ASPX Webshel​​l 土耳其的汽車產業是國民經濟的重要貢獻者，擁有主要的製造中心和出口業務。如果攻擊者利用高階管理存取權限，這種規模的違規行為可能會暴露敏感的智慧財產權、供應鏈資料或客戶資訊。截至報告發佈時，受影響組織的具體身份尚未披露，所指控的違規行為尚未得到獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Access to 100+ Turkish VPN Servers A post on an underground forum claims that a threat actor has gained super administrator access to more than 100 FortiGate devices belonging to a Turkish VPN provider. According to the listing, the actor alleges control over both SSH and web panel interfaces for the network infrastructure, which reportedly runs on Windows, Linux, and virtual machine environments. The actor, identifying as part of the "ALPHA-GROUP," claims the target organization generates $500 million in revenue. The listing enumerates the following details regarding the alleged breach: * **Target:** A VPN provider based in Turkey * **Access Type:** FortiGate SSH and web panel * **Privilege Level:** Super admin * **Affected Hosts:** More than 100 * **Operating Systems:** Windows, Linux, VMs The actor is reportedly offering access to the compromised infrastructure for $3,000, with the transaction to be conducted via Tox and escrow services. If authentic, such widespread administrative access to a major VPN provider's edge devices could allow attackers to intercept traffic, bypass encryption, or pivot into internal corporate networks. At the time of reporting, the specific identity of the VPN provider has not been disclosed, and the alleged breach has not been independently verified. #DataBreach #VPN #Turkey #FortiGate #DarkWeb #CyberSecurity #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱可以存取 100 多個土耳其 VPN 伺服器 地下論壇上的一篇貼文聲稱，威脅行為者已獲得對屬於土耳其 VPN 提供者的 100 多個 FortiGate 設備的超級管理員存取權。根據清單，攻擊者聲稱控製網路基礎架構的 SSH 和 Web 面板介面，據報導該基礎架構在 Windows、Linux 和虛擬機器環境上運作。這位演員自稱為“ALPHA-GROUP”的一部分，聲稱目標組織創造了 5 億美元的收入。該清單列舉了有關涉嫌違規的以下詳細資訊： * **目標：** 位於土耳其的一家 VPN 提供者 * **存取類型：** FortiGate SSH 和 Web 面板 * **權限等級：** 超級管理員 * **受影響的主機：** 超過 100 個 * **作業系統：** Windows、Linux、VM 報告，攻擊者以託管服務的價格將透過交付提供者對 Tox 和基礎來存取設施的基礎。如果屬實，對主要 VPN 提供者邊緣設備的如此廣泛的管理存取可能會讓攻擊者攔截流量、繞過加密或進入內部公司網路。截至發稿時，VPN 提供者的具體身分尚未披露，所指控的違規行為尚未得到獨立核實。 #DataBreach #VPN #土耳其 #FortiGate #DarkWeb #Cyber​​Security #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 275M Airbnb Records Leaked on Darkweb Forum A post on an underground forum claims that a database containing 275 million records belonging to Airbnb has been exposed. The actor alleges the leak includes sensitive user data such as email addresses, hashed passwords, phone numbers, and financial details. According to the listing, the exposed dataset contains the following fields: * User identifiers (user_id) * Contact information (email, phone, country, city) * Authentication data (password_hash using bcrypt $2y$10$ format) * Personal details (first_name, last_name) * Account activity (created_at, last_active_at, account_status) * Financial and booking history (payment_method, trips_taken, total_bookings, host_earnings) * Verification status (email_verified, phone_verified, identity_verified) The sample data provided in the thread shows entries from users in the United States, United Kingdom, Italy, Mexico, Brazil, Canada, Australia, Germany, and the Netherlands. The records include both guest and host information, with some entries revealing host earnings in local currencies (e.g., GBP, MXN, CAD) and payment methods like Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, and Apple Pay. Airbnb is a global online marketplace for short-term homestays and experiences, serving millions of users worldwide. A breach of this scale would represent a significant compromise of personally identifiable information (PII) and financial data. If authentic, the exposure of password hashes could facilitate credential stuffing attacks across other platforms where users reuse passwords. At the time of reporting, Airbnb has not issued a public statement regarding this specific incident, and the alleged breach has not been independently verified.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱 2.75 億 Airbnb 記錄在暗網論壇上洩露 地下論壇上的一篇帖子聲稱，包含 2.75 億 Airbnb 記錄的數據庫已被洩露。該行為者聲稱洩露的內容包括敏感的用戶數據，例如電子郵件地址、散列密碼、電話號碼和財務詳細資訊。根據清單，暴露的資料集包含以下欄位： * 使用者識別碼（user_id） * 聯絡資訊（電子郵件、電話、國家、城市） * 驗證資料（使用 bcrypt $2y$10$ 格式的密碼_雜湊） * 個人詳細資料（名字、姓氏） * 帳戶活動（created_at、last_active_at、account_status） trips_taken、total_bookings、 host_earnings) * 驗證狀態（email_verified、phone_verified、identity_verified） 主題中提供的範例資料顯示來自美國、英國、義大利、墨西哥、巴西、加拿大、澳洲、德國和荷蘭的使用者的條目。這些記錄包括客人和房東訊息，其中一些條目顯示了房東以當地貨幣（例如英鎊、墨西哥比索、加幣）計算的收入以及 Visa、Mastercard、PayPal 和 Apple Pay 等付款方式。 Airbnb 是一個提供短期寄宿和體驗的全球線上市場，為全球數百萬用戶提供服務。違反此規模將意味著個人識別資訊 (PII) 和財務資料受到重大損害。如果是真實的，密碼雜湊的暴露可能會促進使用者在其他平台上重複使用密碼的撞庫攻擊。截至發稿時，Airbnb 尚未就這一具體事件發表公開聲明，所指控的違規行為尚未得到獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged BlaBlaCar Breach Exposes 140M User Records on Darkweb A darkweb forum post claims that a database containing 140 million user records from BlaBlaCar, the French carpooling and travel platform, has been leaked. The listing, posted under the title "BlaBlaCar 140M," alleges the exposure of sensitive personal and account data for users across multiple countries. According to the sample data provided in the thread, the alleged dump includes a wide range of personally identifiable information (PII) and account details. The exposed fields reportedly include: * User IDs and email addresses * Password hashes (bcrypt format) * Full names and gender * Phone numbers and verification statuses * Geographic data (country, city) * Account activity metrics (rides as driver/passenger, ratings, wallet balances) * Vehicle information (make and model) * App version and signup platform BlaBlaCar is a significant player in the European mobility sector, operating in over 22 countries and serving tens of millions of active members annually. The company connects drivers with empty seats to passengers traveling in the same direction. If authentic, the exposure of password hashes and phone numbers could facilitate credential stuffing attacks or targeted phishing campaigns against its user base. At the time of reporting, BlaBlaCar has not issued a public statement regarding this specific incident, and the breach has not been independently verified by third-party security researchers.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 涉嫌 BlaBlaCar 洩露在暗網上洩露了 1.4 億用戶記錄 一篇暗網論壇帖子聲稱，法國拼車和旅行平台 BlaBlaCar 包含 1.4 億用戶記錄的數據庫已被洩露。該清單以「BlaBlaCar 140M」為標題發布，聲稱多個國家/地區的用戶的敏感個人和帳戶資料遭到洩露。根據線程中提供的樣本數據，所謂的轉儲包括廣泛的個人識別資訊 (PII) 和帳戶詳細資訊。根據報告，暴露的欄位包括： * 用戶 ID 和電子郵件地址 * 密碼雜湊（bcrypt 格式） * 全名和性別 * 電話號碼和驗證狀態 * 地理資料（國家、城市） * 帳戶活動指標（司機/乘客乘車、評級、錢包餘額） * 車輛資訊（品牌和型號） * 應用程式版本和平台版本和平台每年都超過 2 個行動裝置的重要領域。該公司將空座的司機與同向行駛的乘客連接起來。如果是真實的，密碼雜湊值和電話號碼的暴露可能會促進針對其用戶群的撞庫攻擊或有針對性的網路釣魚活動。截至發稿時，BlaBlaCar 尚未就這一具體事件發表公開聲明，該漏洞尚未得到第三方安全研究人員的獨立驗證。

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged Database Dump of China's Army Engineering University Exposes 32,797 Records A post on an underground forum claims to have dumped a database containing personal information of faculty and students from the Army Engineering University of the People's Liberation Army (PLA) in China. The listing alleges that 32,797 records were extracted from the institution's systems, associated with the domain http://aeu.edu.cn. According to the post, the leaked dataset includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) and military-specific identifiers. The exposed data fields reportedly include: * Full names * Roles (e.g., student, teacher) * Military codes * Sexuality/Gender * Partial email addresses * Partial phone numbers * Academic departments The Army Engineering University of the PLA is a significant military educational institution responsible for training engineering and technical personnel for the Chinese military. The exposure of military codes and internal roles could potentially aid in social engineering attacks or intelligence gathering against current and former personnel. Samples provided in the thread show CSV-formatted entries with student IDs, names, and status markers such as "Unverified" (未认证). The actor behind the leak has offered the full dataset for sale via direct message on Telegram. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or official statements from the PLA or the university.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 涉嫌轉儲中國陸軍工程大學資料庫，暴露 32,797 條記錄 地下論壇上的一個帖子聲稱轉儲了包含中國陸軍工程大學師生個人資訊的資料庫。该清单称，从该机构的系统中提取了 32,797 条记录，这些记录与域名 http://aeu.edu.cn 相关。根据该帖子，泄露的数据集包括敏感的个人身份信息（PII）和军事专用标识符。據報道，暴露的資料欄位包括： * 全名 * 角色（例如學生、教師） * 軍事代碼 * 性取向/性別 * 部分電子郵件地址 * 部分電話號碼 * 學術部門 中國人民解放軍陸軍工程大學是一所重要的軍事教育機構，負責為中國軍隊培訓工程技術人員。军事代码和内部角色的暴露可能有助于针对现任和前任人员的社会工程攻击或情报收集。线程中提供的示例显示了 CSV 格式的条目，其中包含学生 ID、姓名和状态标记，例如“未验证”（未认证）。泄密事件的幕后黑手已通过 Telegram 上的私信提供了完整的数据集供出售。截至報告發佈時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到安全研究人員的獨立證實，也沒有得到解放軍或大學的官方聲明。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of SEKISUI Aerospace ITAR Data on Darkweb A darkweb forum post alleges the theft and sale of 70 GB of sensitive engineering data belonging to SEKISUI Aerospace Corporation, a U.S.-based Tier 1 supplier for major defense contractors. The actor claims to possess export-controlled technical data, including engineering drawings, STEP files, and bills of materials related to Boeing 737 and 787 programs, as well as components for NASA, Lockheed Martin, and Northrop Grumman. According to the listing, the stolen package contains highly specific technical artifacts marked as “EXPORT CONTROLLED – EAR 9E991 / ITAR Technical Data.” The post enumerates the following contents: • Technical PDF files containing engineering drawings • Complete STEP files in AP242 format for CATIA V5-6R2022 and SolidWorks 2018–2024 • Full Bills of Materials with authentic Boeing part numbers • Complete tooling and fixture data for the Boeing 737 MAX Keel Skin Splice Strap, Boeing 787 Section 41 Nose, and interior panel assemblies • Material specifications including carbon fiber prepreg, thermoplastic PEI and PPS, aluminum 6061-T6, and titanium inserts • Tolerances down to ±0.0005 inch with GD&T in accordance with ASME Y14.5 • Three-dimensional models of assembly tools including drill jigs, trim fixtures, bonding fixtures, and all related bushings and locator hardware with real Carr Lane and McMaster-Carr part numbers • Process specification documents compliant with Boeing BAC requirements The threat actor is reportedly asking for $200,000 USD for the data, stating that the price can be negotiated. The data allegedly includes precision assembly tooling and thermoplastic components used in fuselage, wing, keel beam, and interior structures. Because the materials are subject to strict U.S. export controls under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), their unauthorized disclosure could carry significant legal and national security implications for the affected entities. SEKISUI Aerospace Corporation is a subsidiary of Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd., a major Japanese chemical manufacturer. As a direct supplier to Boeing and other critical defense primes, the company plays a vital role in the aerospace supply chain. If authentic, exposure of internal repositories could enable intellectual property theft and infrastructure targeting. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified. #DataBreach #SEKISUIAerospace #ITAR #Boeing #DefenseIndustry #DarkWeb #CyberSecurity

posts.text_zh: StealC v3 發布。廣告讀起來幾乎與 v2 相同。我猜他們所做的只是重做使用者介面，以便研究人員可以尋找新的漏洞。請記住，這些傢伙的 v2 中有如此多的漏洞，甚至 LEA 都嘲笑他們，而 LEA 還表明他們竊取了客戶日誌。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: How are threat actors turning Microsoft 365 calendars into covert command-and-control infrastructure? Our latest research breaks down HOLLOWGRAPH's Graph API abuse, DNS tunneling credential refresh mechanism, links to the Cavern framework, and the tradecraft behind this targeted campaign. Read the full technical analysis here: https://link.group-ib.com/4wS8490
posts.text_zh: R 詢問@GroupIB_TI：威脅行為者如何將 Microsoft 365 日曆轉變為隱藏的命令與控制基礎架構？我們的最新研究詳細分析了 HOLLOWGRAPH 的 Graph API 濫用、DNS 隧道憑證刷新機制、Cavern 框架的連結以及該針對性活動背後的交易技術。請在此處閱讀完整的技術分析：https://link.group-ib.com/4wS8490

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Group-IB identified at least 12 compromised systems carrying #HOLLOWGRAPH, with only three actively communicating with attacker infrastructure during the observation period. The limited victim count, combined with Israeli-linked infrastructure and telemetry, suggests a highly targeted espionage operation rather than broad opportunistic #malware deployment.
posts.text_zh: R 致 @GroupIB_TI：Group-IB 識別出至少 12 個具有 #HOLLOWGRAPH 的受感染系統，其中在觀察期間只有 3 個系統主動與攻擊者基礎設施進行通訊。有限的受害者數量，加上與以色列相關的基礎設施和遙測技術，表明這是一次高度針對性的間諜活動，而不是廣泛的機會主義#惡意軟體部署。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: HOLLOWGRAPH supports only two commands, "get" and "send", yet maintains persistence of its cloud communications through DNS tunneling. Using specially crafted IPv6 AAAA queries to cloudlanecdn[.]com, the malware refreshes Microsoft Entra ID credentials required to authenticate to its Microsoft Graph-based C2 channel. #MalwareAnalysis
posts.text_zh: R 至 @GroupIB_TI：HOLLOWGRAPH 僅支援兩個命令“獲取”和“發送”，但透過 DNS 隧道保持其雲端通訊的持久性。此惡意軟體使用特製的 IPv6 AAAA 查詢 cloudlanecdn[.]com，刷新對基於 Microsoft Graph 的 C2 通道進行身份驗證所需的 Microsoft Entra ID 憑證。 #惡意軟體分析

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Instead of using traditional C2 infrastructure, #HOLLOWGRAPH stores operator tasking and stolen data inside calendar events scheduled for 13 May 2050. The implant retrieves commands from encrypted attachments and uploads exfiltrated files back to the same mailbox as File{n}.txt attachments, using separate RSA key pairs and AES-256-GCM encryption for each communication direction. Defenders should hunt for calendar events with Event ID: <taskid> {} subjects or the Boss{}ID{} naming convention. #ThreatIntel #APT
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：#HOLLOWGRAPH 不使用傳統的 C2 基礎設施，而是將操作員任務和被盜資料儲存在計畫於 2050 年 5 月 13 日的日曆事件中。植入程式從加密附件中檢索命令，並將洩漏的檔案上傳回與 File{n}.txt 附件相同的郵箱，每個通訊方向使用單獨的 RSA 金鑰對和 AES-256-GCM 加密。防禦者應尋找具有事件 ID 的日曆事件：<taskid> {} 主題或 Boss{}ID{} 命名約定。 #威脅英特爾#APT

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: #HOLLOWGRAPH is a newly identified Windows malware linked with high confidence to the Cavern framework. The #malware abuses Microsoft Graph API and a compromised #Microsoft365 mailbox, transforming the victim's calendar into a two-way dead drop for command-and-control and data exfiltration while blending malicious traffic into legitimate Microsoft cloud communications. #CyberSecurity
posts.text_zh: #HOLLOWGRAPH 是一種新發現的 Windows 惡意軟體，與 Cavern 框架高度相關。 #malware 濫用 Microsoft Graph API 和受損的 #Microsoft365 郵箱，將受害者的日曆轉變為用於命令和控制和資料外洩的雙向死點，同時將惡意流量混合到合法的 Microsoft 雲端通訊中。 #網路安全

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Group-IB Threat Intelligence has already identified 100+ ClickLock Stealer victims across 33 countries since May 2026, proving that macOS threats are evolving beyond rare, sophisticated attacks. The malware uses compromised WordPress infrastructure for payload delivery and self-deletes after execution, leaving minimal forensic traces. Read Group-IB's full technical breakdown here: https://link.group-ib.com/4gC4lHJ
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：自 2026 年 5 月以來，Group-IB 威脅情報已在 33 個國家/地區識別出 100 多個 ClickLock Stealer 受害者，證明 macOS 威脅正在演變為超越罕見、複雜的攻擊。該惡意軟體使用受損的 WordPress 基礎設施進行有效負載傳輸，並在執行後自行刪除，留下最少的取證痕跡。請在此處閱讀 Group-IB 的完整技術細分：https://link.group-ib.com/4gC4lHJ

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: The #malware targets 8 browsers, 31 #cryptowallet extensions, 7 password managers, and 8 desktop wallet applications. Using a modular architecture, ClickLock Stealer employs a GSocket backdoor installer disguised as iCloud, a credential stealer, Keychain stealer, and crypto-focused harvester that extracts #blockchain addresses across 6 chains. All components exfiltrate data via #Telegram Bot API, while the backdoor provides persistent remote access.
posts.text_zh: R 至 @GroupIB_TI：#malware 的目標是 8 個瀏覽器、31 個 #cryptowallet 擴充功能、7 個密碼管理器和 8 個桌面錢包應用程式。 ClickLock Stealer 採用模組化架構，採用偽裝成 iCloud 的 GSocket 後門安裝程式、憑證竊取程式、鑰匙圈竊取程式和以加密貨幣為中心的收割機，可跨 6 個鏈提取 #blockchain 位址。所有元件都透過#Telegram Bot API 竊取數據，而後門則提供持久的遠端存取。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: #ClickLockStealer implements a layered approach to credential theft. If a victim enters their password willingly, the attack completes in seconds. If they refuse, the #malware installs LaunchAgents for persistence and activates a kill-loop terminating Finder, Dock, SystemUIServer, and Terminal every 210 milliseconds, leaving only a fake password dialog on screen until #compliance is achieved. The same coercion technique forces approval of a macOS Keychain authorization prompt to extract Chrome's Safe Storage AES key.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：#ClickLockStealer 實作了一種分層的憑證竊取方法。如果受害者自願輸入密碼，攻擊將在幾秒鐘內完成。如果他們拒絕，#malware 會安裝 LaunchAgents 以實現持久性，並每 210 毫秒啟動一個終止循環，終止 Finder、Dock、SystemUIServer 和終端，只在螢幕上留下一個假密碼對話框，直到實作 #compliance。同樣的強制技術會強制批准 macOS 鑰匙圈授權提示，以擷取 Chrome 的安全儲存 AES 金鑰。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: A new #macOS stealer named #ClickLockStealer has been discovered with zero detections on VirusTotal, targeting users across Europe, North America, and MEA. The malware uses #ClickFix social engineering to trick victims into pasting a malicious command into Terminal, then forces password entry killing all visible applications until the user complies, acting as a "locker". The attack chain requires no exploits or elevated privileges to succeed. #ThreatIntel
posts.text_zh: 在 VirusTotal 上發現了一種名為 #ClickLockStealer 的新 #macOS 竊取程序，其目標是歐洲、北美和中東和非洲地區的用戶，檢測結果為零。該惡意軟體使用 #ClickFix 社交工程來誘騙受害者將惡意命令粘貼到終端中，然後強制輸入密碼以殺死所有可見應用程序，直到用戶遵守為止，充當“儲物櫃”。攻擊鏈無需利用任何漏洞或提升權限即可成功。 #威脅英特爾

Read the full analysis here: https://link.group-ib.com/3ST0nR9
posts.text_zh: R 對@GroupIB_TI：RedHook 如何實現持久性和特權濫用？這項技術深入探討了惡意軟體的自助 ADB 利用、持久性技術、擴展的 C2 基礎設施以及不斷發展的行動威脅情勢。請在此處閱讀完整分析：https://link.group-ib.com/3ST0nR9

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Beyond Vietnam, RedHook has expanded targeting to include users in Indonesia, signaling a broader regional focus across Southeast Asia. Distribution occurs through spoofed government and financial websites, with malicious #APK payloads hosted on trusted platforms including AWS S3 buckets and #GitHub repositories to enhance delivery reliability.#AndroidSecurity
posts.text_zh: R 致 @GroupIB_TI：除了越南之外，RedHook 還擴大了目標範圍，將印尼用戶納入其中，這表明 RedHook 將更加關注整個東南亞地區。透過欺騙性的政府和金融網站進行分發，惡意#APK有效負載託管在受信任的平台上，包括AWS S3儲存桶和#GitHub儲存庫，以增強交付可靠性。 #AndroidSecurity

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: RedHook integrates code from the #Shizuku framework to execute protected system APIs once ADB Wireless Debugging is enabled. The malware navigates Settings screens through Accessibility gestures, enabling Developer Options and pairing with its own ADB daemon. #MalwareAnalysis
posts.text_zh: R 到 @GroupIB_TI：RedHook 整合 #Shizuku 框架中的程式碼，以便在啟用 ADB 無線偵錯後執行受保護的系統 API。該惡意軟體透過輔助功能手勢導航「設定」螢幕，啟用「開發人員選項」並與其自己的 ADB 守護程式配對。 #惡意軟體分析

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: #RedHook Android RAT has returned with a dangerous upgrade. The malware now autonomously abuses ADB Wireless Debugging to obtain shell-level privileges (uid 2000) without requiring root access. This is the first observed instance of a #malware leveraging this technique for privilege abuse in the wild. #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: #RedHook Android RAT 带着危险的升级回来了。该恶意软件现在自动滥用 ADB 无线调试来获取 shell 级权限 (uid 2000)，而无需 root 访问权限。这是第一个观察到的 #malware 利用此技术在野外滥用权限的实例。 #威脅情報

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Security teams are facing a complex adversary landscape where arrests of a few individuals do not stop the overall threat. The decentralized nature of Scattered Spider and its subclusters makes it a constantly evolving menace, focused on social engineering to bypass traditional MFA. Gain a comprehensive understanding of their tactics, objectives, and how the collective operates. Read the full blog here: https://link.group-ib.com/4ba31rU
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：安全團隊面臨複雜的對手形勢，逮捕少數人並不能阻止整體威脅。 Scattered Spider 及其子群集的去中心化性質使其成為一種不斷發展的威脅，專注於社會工程以繞過傳統的 MFA。全面了解他們的策略、目標以及集體的運作方式。在此閱讀完整部落格：https://link.group-ib.com/4ba31rU

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: The primary vector for ScatteredSpider’s initial access is highly targeted social engineering, but it relies on a specific toolset to exploit human trust. Subclusters deploy sophisticated #phishing kits that mimic Okta, Microsoft, and Citrix login pages, sometimes only kept online for a few minutes during a phone call. Our deep dive reveals how these attacks are orchestrated, combining vishing and smishing techniques to direct victims to credential-harvesting sites before delivering a #RAT or other payload.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：ScatteredSpider 初始訪問的主要向量是高度針對性的社會工程，但它依賴於特定的工具集來利用人類信任。子叢集部署複雜的 #phishing 工具包，模仿 Okta、Microsoft 和 Citrix 登入頁面，有時僅在通話期間保持線上幾分鐘。我們深入研究了這些攻擊是如何精心策劃的，結合了語音釣魚和網路釣魚技術，在傳遞 #RAT 或其他有效負載之前將受害者引導至憑證收集網站。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Our analysis shows that Scattered Spider subclusters consistently target employees of major identity providers and marketing platforms like Twilio and Mailchimp as a stepping stone. The end goal is rarely the initial victim; it's to leverage internal tools for phishing campaigns against #cryptocurrency users. Simultaneous operations targeting #Okta login pages and crypto wallets prove the primary objective across these independent subclusters remains financial gain through crypto theft.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：我們的分析表明，分散的蜘蛛子集群始終以主要身份提供商和營銷平台（如 Twilio 和 Mailchimp）的員工作為墊腳石。最終目標很少是最初的受害者；它是利用內部工具針對#cryptocurrency 用戶進行網路釣魚活動。針對 #Okta 登入頁面和加密錢包的同時操作證明，這些獨立子集群的主要目標仍然是透過加密盜竊獲得經濟利益。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Beyond digital #socialengineering, one ScatteredSpider subcluster has been observed resorting to physical theft, specifically stealing employee iPads from mobile carrier retail stores. To bypass device locks, attackers would impersonate internal departments to socially engineer the passcode from store staff. This hybrid physical-digital tactic highlights the lengths these subclusters will go to for SIM swapping operations, targeting telco employees and authorized retailers like Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile. #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：除了數字#socialengineering 之外，還觀察到一個 ScatteredSpider 子集群採取物理盜竊手段，特別是從移動運營商零售店竊取員工的 iPad。為了繞過設備鎖，攻擊者會冒充內部部門，對商店員工的密碼進行社會設計。這種實體-數位混合策略凸顯了這些子叢集將在 SIM 交換作業上花費大量時間，目標是電信員工和 Verizon、AT&T 和 T-Mobile 等授權零售商。 #威脅情報

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: Recent research reveals that #ScatteredSpider is not a singular organized group but a decentralized #cybercrime collective comprised of multiple, independent subclusters. This loose affiliation of operators, connected primarily through shared TTPs and social engineering techniques, poses a unique challenge for attribution. Our latest analysis explains how this structure, akin to a hacking movement, provides inherent resilience against #lawenforcement actions. It's not a single group to track, but a persistent culture of cybercrime that evolves continuously.
posts.text_zh: 最近的研究表明，#ScatteredSpider 並不是一個單一的有組織團體，而是由多個獨立子集群組成的去中心化的#cybercrime 集體。營運商的這種鬆散聯繫（主要透過共享 TTP 和社會工程技術進行連接）對歸因提出了獨特的挑戰。我們的最新分析解釋了這種類似於駭客運動的結構如何提供針對#lawenforcement 行動的固有彈性。它不是一個需要追蹤的單一群體，而是一種持續發展的持續網路犯罪文化。

posts.text: #MilleniumRAT (v4.x) marks a significant evolution in the threat landscape. The #malware has been completely rewritten from .NET to a native C++ application, removing .NET dependencies. This architectural shift enables greater stealth and resilience, making detection more challenging. The #Telegram Bot API remains the core C2 mechanism.

posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: SilabRAT places significant emphasis on #cryptocurrency theft. These additions reflect the growing focus on direct monetization within modern #malware ecosystems.
posts.text_zh: R 致 @GroupIB_TI：SilabRAT 非常重視#cryptocurrency 竊盜。除了收集憑證和瀏覽器資料之外，它還可以識別與錢包相關的工件，並使用從受感染系統收集的憑證自動嘗試恢復密碼。這些新增內容反映了現代#惡意軟體生態系統中對直接貨幣化的日益關注。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: One of SilabRAT's most notable capabilities is its use of Hidden Virtual Network Computing (HVNC). By interacting with services directly from the victim's device, attackers can perform account activity, access sensitive platforms, and conduct fraudulent operations while appearing as a legitimate user originating from the trusted device and IP address. #InfoSec
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：SilabRAT 最顯著的功能之一是它使用隱藏虛擬網路運算 (HVNC)。透過直接從受害者的裝置與服務交互，攻擊者可以執行帳戶活動、存取敏感平台並進行詐騙操作，同時表現為來自受信任裝置和 IP 位址的合法使用者。 #資訊安全

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: #SilabRAT is a newly emerging Malware-as-a-Service (#MaaS) platform developed by the threat actor "o1oo1" and advertised on underground forums since late 2025. Sold for $5,000 per month, the Remote Access Trojan (#RAT) combines credential theft, session hijacking, HVNC access, Chrome App-Bound Encryption bypasses using COM elevation, and cryptocurrency-focused tooling into a single platform built for financially motivated cybercrime.
posts.text_zh: #SilabRAT 是一個新興的惡意軟體即服務 (#MaaS) 平台，由威脅行為者「o1oo1」開發，自 2025 年底以來在地下論壇上做廣告。遠端存取木馬 (#RAT) 每月售價 5,000 美元，將憑證盜竊、會話劫持、HVNC 存取、使用 COM 提升的 Chrome 應用程式綁定加密繞過以及以加密貨幣為中心的工具整合到一個為出於經濟動機的網路犯罪。

posts.text: TeamT5 will be exhibiting at Cyber Defense Symposium Atami 2026, a premier event focused on defense and national security. As Japan continues to advance its Active Cyber Defense initiatives, proactive cybersecurity capabilities have become more critical than ever. At our booth, we will showcase our APAC-focused #ThreatIntelligence and #ThreatHunting solutions, designed to help organizations identify, understand, and respond to emerging cyber threats with greater speed and precision. 📅 June 20 (Sat.) ~ June 21 (Sun.) 📍 Atami Korakuen Hotel (Atami City, Shizuoka, Japan) 👉More details: https://www.5th-battlefield.com/ #5thbf @Battlefield5th

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: Hey @elonmusk, since you don't seem to have much a media/comms team anymore, can you address the apparently legitimate claim that someone scraped & is now selling data on hundreds of millions of Twitter accounts? Maybe it didn't happen on your watch, but you owe Twitter a reply.
posts.text_zh: 嘿@elonmusk，既然你似乎不再有太多的媒體/通訊團隊，你能解決一下有人在數億個 Twitter 帳戶上抓取並出售數據的明顯合法的說法嗎？也許這不是在你手錶上發生的，但你欠 Twitter 一個回應。

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: Just enjoyed several glorious days when I didn't even think about Twitter. Wandered back just now to see what's new, and yep about what I expected.
posts.text_zh: 只是享受了幾天美好的時光，我什至沒有想到推特。剛才又回來看看有什麼新鮮事，是的，關於我所期望的。

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: This article could easily be updated to reflect the current reason a lot of people here (particularly journalists) have their accounts locked: It slows the firehose of bot replies from gajillions of accounts that don't follow you. It's probably also come to mean FU to Twitter.
posts.text_zh: 這篇文章可以輕鬆更新，以反映當前許多人（尤其是記者）的帳戶被鎖定的原因：它減慢了來自無數不關注您的帳戶的機器人回复的速度。對 Twitter 來說，它也可能意味著 FU。
